name: unsafe fn write_unlock (& self)
rule: To call `RwLock::write_unlock` safely, the `RwLock` must be write-locked with a single writer.
api: impl  std::sys::sync::rwlock::futex::RwLock { unsafe fn write_unlock (& self) }
